basics.name: Yiming Du
basics.label: PhD Student | Natural Language Processing
basics.summary: PhD student at CUHK working on memory-augmented LLM agents, long-term memory, and reasoning in multi-session dialogues.

location.address: MoE Lab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong

education.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
education.area: System Engineering and Engineering Management (Minor in NLP)
courses: Research focus: memory-augmented dialogue systems, long-term memory in LLM agents

education.area: Computer Science & Engineering (Minor in Software Engineering)

work.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, MoE Lab
highlights: Memory-Augmented Agents: novel long-term memory agent with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Reinforcement Learning under multi-session dialogues.

work.name: Huawei, Noah's Ark Lab
highlights: Temporal Reasoning: developed an RL framework to improve temporal reasoning for LLM agents.

work.name: The University of Edinburgh, Informatics Forum
highlights: Personal Agent: explore parametric memory and contextual memory in personal assistants.

work.name: SenseTime
highlights: Data Selection: explore high-quality multi-turn dialogues for SFT and RL training.
Multi-turn Dialogue System: developed a noise-robust SFT pipeline for Edge LLMs.

work.name: Huawei, Noah's Ark Lab
highlights: Memory in LLM Dialogue System: led the creation of a memory-based LLM dialogue system with RAG framework and FAISS vector databases.

work.name: City University of Hong Kong, Web Mining Lab
highlights: Sentence Classification: developed the DPCIPI model based on DNABERT for viral gene similarity evaluation.

work.name: Imperial College London
highlights: Sentiment Classification: news headline sentiment analysis using BERT.

work.name: Southeast University, Atur Lab
highlights: Text Generation: research on middle-representation language Pseudo-SQL to generate comparative questions.
